**[Recall Knowledge - Humanoid](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14)): DC 37 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 35 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 32 [Vharnev The Butcher](/NPCs.aspx?ID=2544) **Source** [Pathfinder #190: The Choosing](/Sources.aspx?ID=198) pg. 20 **Perception** +14; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12) **Languages** [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Infernal](/Languages.aspx?ID=19) **Skills** [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2) +19, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +21, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +20, [Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14) +19, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +15 **Str** +5 **Dex** +1 **Con** +2 **Int** +3 **Wis** +0 **Cha** +4 **Items** _+2 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [wounding](/Equipment.aspx?ID=309) [battle axe](/Weapons.aspx?ID=16)_, _+1 [half plate](/Armor.aspx?ID=12)_, _steel-colored [bird feather token](/Equipment.aspx?ID=244), _ _uniila witch token_ --- **AC** 29 **Fort** +20 **Ref** +18 **Will** +18 **HP** 180 **[Attack of Opportunity](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=3)**
**Defensive Charm** ([abjuration](/Traits.aspx?ID=2), [arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), manipulation)
Trigger** Vharnev is the target of a ranged attack** **Effect** Vharnev quickly traces a defensive rune between himself and the source of the ranged attack, giving him a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. --- **Speed** 25 feet **Melee** _battle axe_ +23 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Sweep](/Traits.aspx?ID=194)), **Damage** 2d8+11 slashing plus 1d6 [persistent bleed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) **Arcane Spontaneous Spells** DC 26, attack +18 - **Cantrips (5th)** [Acid Splash](/Spells.aspx?ID=3), [Dancing Lights](/Spells.aspx?ID=58), [Electric Arc](/Spells.aspx?ID=97), [Prestidigitation](/Spells.aspx?ID=229), [Telekinetic Projectile](/Spells.aspx?ID=334) - **3rd** [Earthbind](/Spells.aspx?ID=94), [Haste](/Spells.aspx?ID=147) (2 slots) - **4th** [Dispel Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=78), [Phantasmal Killer](/Spells.aspx?ID=219) (2 slots) - **5th** [Magic Missile](/Spells.aspx?ID=180), [Weapon Storm](/Spells.aspx?ID=373) (2 slots) **Sorcerer Bloodline Spells** DC 26, 2 Focus Points - **5th** [Ancestral Memories](/Spells.aspx?ID=493), [Extend Spell](/Spells.aspx?ID=507) **Sudden Charge** Vharnev Strides twice and makes a melee Strike. **Uniila Witch Token** Vharnev bears the [uniila](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2520)'s witch token in the form of an amulet with [Mahathallah](/Deities.aspx?ID=170)'s rune-ringed eye symbol. Vharnev's spells lower than 5th level count as 1 level higher for the purpose of being [counteracted](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) and counteracting other spells. Once per day, Vharnev can activate the token to cast [_confusion_](/Spells.aspx?ID=48) (DC 29).
name: Vharnev The Butcher
